response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), player_counts AS (SELECT p.player_id, COALESCE(a.award_count, 0) AS award_count FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN award_counts AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count FROM player_counts) SELECT pc.player_id, pc.award_count, 1.0 * pc.award_count / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0) AS fraction FROM player_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
